objective_interpretation: The subject wants to be considered for senior technology leadership roles, so the review treats the site as a decision aid for a hiring audience rather than as a portfolio.

activated_modules.reason: The objective turns on how the subject is understood.
Who has to be convinced is exactly who the recommendations must address.
The site's own language is what a reader tests any recommended change against.
A hiring audience compares candidates by definition.
The writing archive is large enough to shape a conclusion independent of the stated positioning.
The site has a contact path worth assessing.
The subject's presence is a website, so its structure is directly assessable.

dormant_modules.reason: Hiring-market trends are not what this decision turns on.
Nothing is sold or provided as a package; this is a hiring decision, not a commercial one.
How traffic arrives cannot be established from public material and is not the decision at hand.
No commercial offer is being sold through the site.
Not raised in the objective and no evidence of a compliance driver.
No press or third-party sentiment signal was anticipated going in.
No security, privacy or compliance driver applies to a personal site.
Out of scope for a personal positioning review.
No regulatory or macro-economic driver bears on this decision.

comparison_plan.rationale: One comparison was supplied by the subject. The audience compares against a wider set than the subject named, so further candidates were discovered and qualified.

anticipated_gaps: No analytics access, so actual conversion behaviour cannot be observed.
Recruiter decision criteria are inferred from public material rather than interviews.
